title: UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase in 2025
funder: National Human Genome Research Institute [HG002273]; NIH Office of the Director [U24HG007822]; NIAID; NIA; NIGMS [R35GM141873]; NIDDK; NEI; NCI; NHLBI; BBSRC [BB/T015608/1]; National Science Foundation Directorate for Biological Sciences [BB/X002179/1]; Open Targets; Horizon 2020 [825575]; Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation; EMBL Australia.
result: Reviewed UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org. FADS2 (O95864), acyl-CoA 6-desaturase, endoplasmic reticulum membrane: introduces a cis double bond at carbon 6 and catalyses the first and rate-limiting step of highly unsaturated fatty acid synthesis, the desaturation of linoleoyl-CoA (18:2n-6) and alpha-linolenoyl-CoA (18:3n-3) to gamma-linolenoyl-CoA and stearidonoyl-CoA (18:4n-3), with O2 and 2 Fe(II)-cytochrome b5; in the n-3 series it also desaturates tetracosapentaenoyl-CoA (24:5n-3) to tetracosahexaenoyl-CoA (24:6n-3), which is converted to DHA (by similarity); it carries an N-terminal cytochrome b5 domain and three histidine boxes. FADS1 (O60427), acyl-CoA (8-3)-desaturase: front-end desaturase that introduces a cis double bond at carbon 5 and desaturates dihomo-gamma-linolenoyl-CoA (20:3n-6) and eicosatetraenoyl-CoA (20:4n-3) to arachidonoyl-CoA and eicosapentaenoyl-CoA (20:5n-3). ELOVL5 (Q9NYP7): condensing enzyme of the elongation cycle, its first and rate-limiting reaction, acting on polyunsaturated acyl-CoAs including stearidonoyl-CoA and eicosapentaenoyl-CoA with malonyl-CoA and releasing CO2 and CoA. ELOVL2 (Q9NXB9): condensing enzyme for C20 and C22 polyunsaturated acyl-CoAs, including eicosapentaenoyl-CoA and docosapentaenoyl-CoA (22:5n-3), the latter to 3-oxotetracosapentaenoyl-CoA. HSD17B12 (Q53GQ0, NADPH-dependent 3-ketoacyl-CoA reductase), HACD1 to HACD4 (B0YJ81, Q6Y1H2, Q9P035, Q5VWC8; 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydratases) and TECR (Q9NZ01, NADPH-dependent trans-2,3-enoyl-CoA reductase) catalyse the second, third and fourth reactions of the endoplasmic reticulum elongation cycle. ACOX1 (Q15067), peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase 1, FAD: initial and rate-limiting step of peroxisomal beta-oxidation, donating electrons directly to O2 to form H2O2; acts on tetracosahexaenoyl-CoA; possibly regulates systemic DHA through peroxisomal beta-oxidation of 24:6n-3 to DHA. HSD17B4 (P51659), peroxisomal multifunctional enzyme type 2: hydration of 2-enoyl-CoA and NAD+-dependent dehydrogenation of (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA, including the C24 hexaenoyl intermediates. ACAA1 (P09110), peroxisomal 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase: 3-oxo-tetracosahexaenoyl-CoA + CoA = docosahexaenoyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA. ACSL1 (P33121): a long-chain fatty acid + ATP + CoA = a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate. PTGS1 (P23219), prostaglandin G/H synthase 1, haem b, endoplasmic reticulum membrane: dual cyclooxygenase and peroxidase; the cyclooxygenase oxygenates arachidonate (20:4n-6) with 2 O2 to prostaglandin G2 and the peroxidase reduces it to prostaglandin H2, the precursor of all 2-series prostaglandins and thromboxanes. PTGS1 and PTGS2 (P35354) are the targets of NSAIDs including aspirin and ibuprofen; aspirin inactivates the enzyme irreversibly by serine acetylation (Ser-529 in PTGS1).
